title: Deformation theorem in positive codimension (Simon 6.5.1–5.4) and the isoperimetric filling it implies (Simon 6.6.1)
statement: Assume (MR) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every IMRep R of a current T in an open U ⊆ ℝ^P and open W (type of accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure), (IMC) the type of accepted cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub ((a) a.e. locality of approximate tangent spaces for nested Borel sets, (b) restrictions of IMReps to Borel sets, (c) differences of IM currents are IM, (d) |orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.) and (VO) S(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω misses spt S (type of accepted dtc_vanish_off_support). Then (DTr): for P, m with m + 1 < P there is c ∈ ℝ≥0, c ≥ 1, such that for every ρ > 0 and every IM T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, M(T) < ∞ and M(∂T) < ∞ there are Q, S ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) and R ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with Q, ∂Q, R IM, T − Q − S = ∂R, Q = 0 or M(Q) ≥ ρ^{m+1}, M(Q) ≤ cM(T), M(∂Q) ≤ cM(∂T), M(R) ≤ cρM(T), M(S) ≤ cρM(∂T), spt Q ∪ spt R ⊆ thickening(3√Pρ, spt T) and spt ∂Q ∪ spt S ⊆ thickening(3√Pρ, spt ∂T); and (Isor): for P, m with m + 1 < P there is a real c ≥ 1 such that every IM Z ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, ∂Z = 0 and M(Z) < ∞ is ∂Y for an IM Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with M(Y) ≤ c(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}M(Z) and spt Y ⊆ thickening(3√P(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}, spt Z). Notation: SimonGMT currents, M = mass, spt = support, IM = contract IsIntegerMultiplicity.
